subject.title: feat(mobile): default pairing to full node access

question: Should official mobile QR/setup-code pairing intentionally grant effective full Gateway administration by default, rather than requiring users to select Full access explicitly?
rationale: The implementation can constrain where the credential is issued, but tests cannot decide whether the product should trade least privilege for one-scan mobile usability.

options.title: Approve full-by-default
options.body: Accept the proposed official-mobile default after correcting the authority documentation and confirming the exact-head boundary proof.

options.title: Require explicit Full access
options.body: Default setup codes to the bounded profile and make administrative access a deliberate Control UI or CLI selection.

options.title: Keep the current bounded model
options.body: Pause the feature until narrower capabilities can support mobile settings and upgrades without granting effective administration.

recommendation.title: Approve full-by-default
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed official-mobile default after correcting the authority documentation and confirming the exact-head boundary proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied issue and commit history identify this person as the available owner of the proposed mobile pairing direction.
